verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an inference and training platform, so the axis applies, but the evidence pack shows no way to run Together AI's platform on your own infrastructure. Dedicated endpoints, reserved hardware and GPU clusters are all Together-hosted. They are adjacent managed offerings, not self-hosting, and the community comparison to self-hosting on AWS refers to running models without Together.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
